objective: Executable bounded local/static review of immutable commit a2486b255b974ef8432ce44de014931f51552f4b focused on INV-ACCT-10 controller-to-pool position synchronization and liquidation/accounting paths. Return reproducible evidence, an evidence-backed kill/known-design result, or an exact narrowed local-test/runtime blocker.
allowed_methods: git history/diff and public issue/PR dedupe
done_definition: Receipt must identify immutable source, exact files/functions inspected, static findings relevant to INV-ACCT-10, targeted local-test result when runnable, and classify outcome as reproducible deviation / evidence-backed kill or known design / exact narrowed blocker.
expected_reaper_state_transition: Q3 hypothesis created/refined/killed, or Q2 promotion only if local evidence plus novelty/impact prerequisites survive.
command:
set -u
REF='a2486b255b974ef8432ce44de014931f51552f4b'
URL='https://github.com/XOXNO/rs-lending-xlm.git'
W='/tmp/REAPER-XOXNO-20261006-2057-B'
rm -rf "$W"
mkdir -p "$W"
echo '=== SOURCE FREEZE ==='
if ! git clone -q --filter=blob:none --no-checkout "$URL" "$W/repo"; then
  echo 'RESULT=BLOCKED_CLONE_FAILED'
  exit 0
fi
cd "$W/repo"
if ! git checkout -q "$REF"; then
  echo 'RESULT=BLOCKED_CHECKOUT_FAILED'
  exit 0
fi
ACTUAL="$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)"
echo "EXPECTED_REF=$REF"
echo "ACTUAL_REF=$ACTUAL"
if [ "$ACTUAL" != "$REF" ]; then
  echo 'RESULT=BLOCKED_SOURCE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH'
  exit 0
fi

echo '=== INV-ACCT-10 DEFINITION ==='
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('docs/reference/invariants.md')
lines=p.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()
for i,line in enumerate(lines):
    if 'INV-ACCT-10' in line:
        for j in range(i, min(i+18,len(lines))):
            print(f'{j+1}:{lines[j]}')
        break
PY

echo '=== RELEVANT CONTROLLER / POOL SITES ==='
grep -RIn --include='*.rs' -E 'PoolSeizeEntry|PoolPositionMutation|ScaledPositionRaw|seize_positions|net_settle|position_mutation|update_or_remove_(supply|borrow)_position|record_.*position_update' contracts/controller/src contracts/pool/src | head -n 120 || true

echo '=== LIQUIDATION APPLY EXCERPTS ==='
grep -nE 'PoolSeizeEntry|scaled_amount|credit_supply_shares|record_share_credit_updates|update_or_remove_supply_position' contracts/controller/src/positions/liquidation/apply.rs | head -n 120 || true

echo '=== POOL TRUST MODEL ==='
grep -nE 'Positions come in as arguments|scaled_amount.*real position|controller position ledger' contracts/pool/README.md | head -n 40 || true

echo '=== TARGETED LOCAL TEST ==='
TEST_RC=127
if command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  timeout 360s cargo test --manifest-path contracts/controller/Cargo.toml liquidation --lib --quiet >/tmp/xoxno-test.out 2>/tmp/xoxno-test.err
  TEST_RC=$?
  echo "TEST_RC=$TEST_RC"
  echo '--- TEST STDOUT TAIL ---'
  tail -n 40 /tmp/xoxno-test.out || true
  echo '--- TEST STDERR TAIL ---'
  tail -n 40 /tmp/xoxno-test.err || true
else
  echo 'TEST_RC=127'
  echo 'CARGO_UNAVAILABLE'
fi

echo '=== STATIC CLASSIFICATION ==='
if [ "$TEST_RC" = "0" ]; then
  echo 'RESULT=STATIC_REVIEW_COMPLETE_TARGETED_TEST_PASS'
elif [ "$TEST_RC" = "124" ]; then
  echo 'RESULT=STATIC_REVIEW_COMPLETE_TEST_BLOCKED_TIMEOUT'
elif [ "$TEST_RC" = "127" ]; then
  echo 'RESULT=STATIC_REVIEW_COMPLETE_TEST_BLOCKED_TOOLCHAIN_UNAVAILABLE'
else
  echo "RESULT=STATIC_REVIEW_COMPLETE_TEST_NONZERO_$TEST_RC"
fi
echo 'NOTE=Receipt is investigation evidence only. It does not itself establish vulnerability, novelty, impact, submission readiness, award, or payment.'
exit 0
